#215 · Sharp Claw Pokémon

Sneasel

Dark Ice

Johto · Generation 2

Sneasel is a Dark/Ice-type Sharp Claw Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 0.9 m tall and weighs 28 kg. It evolves into Weavile and Sneasler. Its highest base stat is Speed (115), with a base stat total of 430.
